segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive or reactive skin generally report no irritation and a gentle experience, though a few warn newcomers to be cautious and one reported redness and dryness after first use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s-70s describe smoother, softer, less dry and more supple skin with regular use, calling it a long-standing staple.
segments.oily: A reviewer with an oily T-zone reports the product works well for oily skin and helps control it.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal skin says it leaves the face clean and smooth without the rawness or oiliness other scrubs cause.
segments.combination: A reviewer with sensitive skin and an oily T-zone reports the product hydrates while controlling oiliness with no irritation.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers (50s-70s) report smoother, softer, more supple skin and reduced dryness with regular use; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the product leaves skin soft and smooth without dryness, and one mature reviewer reports less dryness and flaking; however one reviewer reported extreme dryness and an allergic-type reaction after a single use.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including those with sensitive skin, report no irritation or redness after use, but one reviewer reported skin turning red the day after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin describe the product as gentle with no irritation despite its exfoliating grit; one exception reports a strong reaction with redness and dryness.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading dark spots and smaller-looking pores after a few weeks of use, with no dissent mentioned.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report fewer breakouts, reduced neck acne, and cleared blackheads/clogged pores around the nose and chin with regular use; no negative reports on blemishes found.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily T-zones report the product manages oiliness well and improves overall skin appearance; no dissent noted.
